title: Aromatic Steamed Tunisian Cheese Tagine
description: A malty, cheese-pull, crowd-pleaser Tunisian dish featuring clotted cream, this recipe is a unique and delicious experience. It is steamed to perfection in a dolsot-stone-bowl.
instructions: Preheat the steamer to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the malt syrup, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the tunisian cheese in the dolsot-stone-bowl and brush the malt syrup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Add the sliced onion on top of the cheese.
Spoon the clotted cream over the onion.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the clotted cream.
Place the dolsot-stone-bowl in the steamer and steam for 20 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the steamer and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the Aromatic Steamed Tunisian Cheese Tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
